chunks: Muhammad ibn Muslim narrated from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام that he said:

If a man doubts after he has performed salat (prayer), and does not know whether he prayed three or four, and at the time he finished he was certain that he had completed it, then he does not repeat the salat (prayer). At the time he finished, he was closer to the truth than he was after that.

key_terms.الْحَقِّ: the correct reality or truth of the matter
key_terms.يَقِينُهُ: his certainty at the time of completion

ai.seo_question: If someone doubts after finishing salat (prayer) whether they prayed three or four rak'ahs, must they repeat it?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about doubt arising after completing salat (prayer). If a person had certainty upon finishing that the prayer was complete, then a later doubt about whether it was three or four rak'ahs does not require repeating the prayer.
